newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse resumes its higher trend.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse resumes its higher trend.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange on Tuesday closed up by 0.18 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 452.03 points, up from 451.24 on Monday.
Chemical firm Alkimia was up 0.5 dinar to 40.5 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.45 dinar to 15.45 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air advanced 0.38 dinar to 23.38 dinars. Insurance firm ASTREE was up 0.2 dinar to 23.
UBCI bank fell 1.26 dinar to 40.74 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie was down 0.4 dinar to 29.1. UIB bank eased 0.17 dinar to 11.33 dinars.
Total volume was 824,023 dinars against 378,241 dinars over the previous session.
